description_en: Queries the configurations of a specified hybrid cloud cluster or a specified compute node
description_zh: 调用GetHybridClusterConfig获取指定混合云集群或指定计算节点的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc get-hybrid-cluster-config --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --node testNode --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHybridClusterConfig

parameters.description_en:
The name of the on-premises compute node. You can call this operation to query the configurations of the on-premises compute node.

By default, the operation queries the configurations of a cluster.
parameters.description_zh:
本地计算节点名称，获取本地计算节点配置信息。

默认获取集群的配置信息。
